scope: Static review of newly supplied implementation and build plan against accepted requirements. No live probes, runtime-hook creation, deployment or activation.
acceptance: Source-linked verdict distinguishing closed findings, missing evidence and remaining blockers, with no claim that static review verifies runtime behavior.
schedule: Existing parent observation cadence unchanged; requested check is not a confirmed exact runtime trigger.
ack_binding: Reference exact message ID and revision; separate receipt, acceptance and scheduling.
